name: ODinW
description: Object Detection in the Wild (ODinW) benchmark for evaluating object detection models' task-level transfer ability across diverse real-world datasets in terms of prediction accuracy and adaptation efficiency
typical_sota_score: ~70-80 mAP on 35-dataset average (frontier grounded detection models as of 2024)
reputation: Standard benchmark for grounded vision-language models; part of the GLIP and Grounding DINO evaluation suite; tests zero-shot and few-shot object detection transfer across 35 datasets
notes: Part of the GLIP (Grounded Language-Image Pre-training) evaluation framework. ODinW-35 contains 35 diverse object detection datasets spanning domains like medical imaging, retail, satellite imagery, and autonomous driving. Tests zero-shot transfer of vision-language models to novel object detection scenarios without task-specific fine-tuning.
